name: Thomas Comerford

conflicts.foundValue: His supposed daughter Alice Comerford was 35 in the 1870 census (b. c.1835)
conflicts.assessment: A father born c.1821 would have been about 14 at Alice's birth. The tree's Thomas Comerford (d. Castlecomer, Co. Kilkenny, 1878) and wife Mary Dowling (b. 1815) have no sources; at best this is a guessed family. Castlecomer is a plausible Comerford district, but nothing links Alice to it.

sources.citation: 1870 U.S. census, Plymouth Township, Luzerne Co., Pa., p.66, enumerated 29 Jul 1870 by Roberson Boyd, P.O. Kingston, dwelling 444, family 446 (image via FamilySearch, attached to G7FL-HGY)
sources.supports: Martin Murphy 50, miner, real estate $1100, personal $200, b. Ireland; Alice 35, keeping house, b. Ireland; Mary 13, Patrick 12, Catherine 9, James 7, John 4, and twins Martin and Thomas aged 1/12, all b. Pennsylvania.
